newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Riksbank sets 7-day repo at unchanged 4.60 pct.
newsitem.headline: Riksbank sets 7-day repo at unchanged 4.60 pct.

text.p: Sweden's central bank, the Riksbank, set on Tuesday a new seven-day reverse repurchase operation at an unchanged fixed rate of 4.60 percent.
The repo will run from November 6 to November 13.
Tuesday's tender was the second of four weekly reverse repo operations to be set at 4.60 percent as foreshadowed by the Riksbank two weeks ago.
The repo rate is the Riksbank's key tool for controlling the liquidity of the money market.
In late October, the Riksbank departed from its strategy of adjusting the repo rate every other week in favour of fixing the repo rate four weeks in advance in line with Bundesbank practice.
Since the start of the year the repo, the central rate in a three tier system, has been cut from 8.91 percent.
The floor and ceiling of the central bank's interest rate corridor, the deposit and lending rates, are set at 4.25 percent and 5.75 percent respectively.
